svg.aria-label: Propranolol, page 2 of 3. Indication Hypertension, angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmias, myocardial infarction prophylaxis, migraine headache prophylaxis, essential tremor, and management of hyperthyroidism/thyrotoxicosis symptoms. Hypertension, angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmias, migraine prophylaxis, essential tremor, and hyperthyroidism symptoms. Contraindication Bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), sinus bradycardia, second-or third-degree heart block, cardiogenic shock, and overt heart failure. Bronchial asthma, severe COPD, sinus bradycardia, second- or third-degree heart block, and cardiogenic shock.
